summary.intent: Close out PR #571 (Changesets v3 pre) by merging origin/feat/changesets-v3-pre and latest origin/main, verifying both fix commits have failing-without-fix tests, running all gates plus mutation testing, then pushing, verifying the signature, and resolving the two Entire findings. The lead also added tasks mid-session: generate a fixture with real Changesets 3.0.3 and update pre-state wording/docs.
summary.outcome: Merged cleanly (f74429a08, signed) and confirmed all three fix tests fail without their fixes and pass with them. The resume test exposed a real failure after the merge, which was investigated. Pre-state help text, docs/errors.md, docs/stability.md and the changeset wording were edited and a signed commit was made after fixing a formatting hook failure. Gates, mutants, push, ls-remote, and finding resolution were not reached in this transcript.

repo: Signed commits and merges fail inside the sandbox because the gpg-agent socket is blocked; they must be rerun outside it.
The pre-commit hook enforces formatting; run `just fmt` before committing or the commit fails.

Checkpoint/resume code for the version command's --emit write arrived via commit 8f9a3a061; the resume-after-archive test depends on it and on how the interruption is simulated (switching the interruption to a directory changed the test behavior).

The Changesets pre-state docs are spread across code help text, docs/errors.md (E114/E115/E243 definitions), docs/stability.md, and the PR's own pre-mode changeset file, so wording changes must be kept consistent across all of them.
Real Changesets 3.0.3 `init` is interactive; no obvious non-interactive path, so fixtures need a different approach (e.g. reading @changesets/pre source or writing files by hand).

code.finding: The resume test fails at line 429 after the merge, and this is a real regression rather than a sandbox artifact. The changelog assertion was tightened from `<= 1` to an exact count because the weaker check could mask a double entry.

workflow: When a test fails in the sandbox, rerun it outside to distinguish sandbox limits from real regressions before debugging.
Verify a fix's test by temporarily reverting the fix and confirming the test fails, then restoring it.
Use a private npm cache under a scratch dir rather than touching ~/.npm when installing tooling for fixtures; avoid scratch commits that disable gpgsign, since the permission layer denied one.

friction: gpg-agent socket blocked in the sandbox, forcing signed merge/commit steps to run outside it.
Resume test failed after the merge, requiring investigation into checkpoint code history.
A scratch-workspace command was denied, likely due to commit.gpgsign=false, and needed to be retried without a commit.
Changesets `init` prompts interactively, forcing a detour into reading package source.
The pre-commit hook failed on formatting, requiring `just fmt` and a second commit attempt.
The lead added two tasks mid-session, expanding scope beyond the original four steps.
open_items: Run just pre-push, just lint, just doc-check, just test and just ci on the merged tree and judge by exit code.
Run cargo mutants --in-place --in-diff on the two fix commits with zero missed or argued equivalents; restore mutants.out.old only if tracked and never commit mutants.out*.
Push with git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/feat/changesets-v3-pre, confirm with git ls-remote, and verify the signature.
Resolve findings 01M7RBYQ9KY9 and 01M7RDA9X3WF with entire trail finding resolve --trail callisto/179.
Report the sha and gate results to the lead session (close-gap-for-alpha), and report any new Entire findings without fixing them.
Complete the lead's added task of generating a fixture with real Changesets 3.0.3, which was only started.
Confirm the resume test failure at line 429 is fully resolved after the merge.
